LayerNorm → Q | KV(LLM) → SDPA → Out Proj + Residual
Key: DiTBlock = Self-Attn + Cross-Attn(LLM) + FFN (all pre-norm, all bidirectional)

- Cross-attention conditions action generation on LLM's language understanding (1550 KV tokens from Qwen3-4B)
